extracted.name: Unsweetened Iced Tea
extracted.description: Perfect unsweetened tea, made with just black tea bags and water, chilled and served over ice for a cold drink that's sure to quench your thirst!
instruction_lines: Put tea bags in a 2-quart pitcher. Add hot water. Let sit at least 15 minutes. Add cold water and remove tea bags.
Refrigerate the tea and serve over ice.
